statement: Retries help until roughly K=4 on independent failures, but the DEFENSIBLE budget is K=3 — beyond it, success gains fall below 0.05 while amplification exceeds 2.0x and p99 breaches 120. Under CORRELATED failures (shared outage + retry storm) retries are near-pure amplification: success plateaus around 0.45 while amplification reaches 4.065x and p99 reaches 256.6 — so the correlated budget is only K=2, and a circuit breaker (Mission 20) is required. The recommendation is capped by the ceilings, so it never trades a success bump for an unacceptable cost/tail cost.
